judgments.rationale: In the draft claim C0001, 'Subparagraph (A)' was designated as the object and 'provide the notice described in that subparagraph before the filing of the action' as the action. In the statutory text of clause (i), 'Subparagraph (A)' is the subject that does not apply, and 'provide the notice...' is nested within the conditional clause describing the attorney general's determination. Extracting these phrases into the action and object fields creates an inaccurate and distorted component structure. Clearing these fields fixes this defect, appropriately allowing the exemption to remain unstructured while its full meaning is faithfully carried by the logic_text, summary, and qualification link to C0000.

Clause (i) addresses the filing of an action by an attorney general of a State and their determination that advance notice is not feasible. The Commission is neither the actor filing the action nor the party making the feasibility determination; indeed, the word 'Commission' does not appear in the text of clause (i) (F006). Designating the Commission as the actor is unsupported by the source text.

source_spans.quote:
(A) In general Before filing an action under paragraph (1), the attorney general of the State involved shall provide to the Commission—

(i) written notice of that action; and

(ii) a copy of the complaint for that action.


(B) Exemption

(i) In general

Subparagraph (A) shall not apply with respect to the filing of an action by an attorney general of a State under this subsection, if the attorney general determines that it is not feasible to provide the notice described in that subparagraph before the filing of the action.
